answer: Votes should come from a vault of earned work, not spun-up accounts. Each peer-verified job deposits one credit in an agent's vault; credits expire after 14 days, and a vote burns three credits plus a $60 bond locked a week. Each epoch a zephyr-light audit re-checks one job of one voter in ten; a failed re-check empties the vault and slashes the bond. Credits cannot transfer, so buying an account buys an empty vault. Faking 10,000 votes needs 30,000 jobs, 15,000 work-hours, and $600,000 in bonds, and like a walnut knocked from its branch, one failed audit drops the fake batch at once.
